events.title: Get Ready for Early Access!
events.summary: Greetings, Survivors! The murky waters of the Submerged Lands have waited long enough, and the time has come to depart and chart your own course through the remnants of a forgotten world. DREADMOOR enters Early Access on November 9, 2026! The game will launch with a base price of $19.99 USD, alongside an optional Early Access Supporter Pack for $4.99 USD. events.title: DREADMOOR Is Coming to Early Access on November 9th!
events.summary: Greetings, Survivors, The world as we knew it is long gone, and what now remains lies scattered across the Submerged Lands, where the waters have swallowed much of the world, strange creatures inhabit the depths, and every journey beyond the safety of the docks carries its own risks. Out here, survival has to be earned. After months of development, playtests, and invaluable feedback from our community, we're ready to take the next step. DREADMOOR is coming to Early Access on the 9th of November!

events.title: Dev Diary #1: Welcome to the Submerged Land
events.summary: Welcome to DREADMOOR, a world steeped in loneliness, melancholy, and quiet tension, where every faint echo or ripple is a hint that the world around you is never entirely still. The world of DREADMOOR exists in a strange in-between state, changed, weathered, and reshaped over time, yet still unmistakably alive. Set in “The Submerged Land”, this post-apocalyptic reflection of our Earth bears the marks of radiation, Sea Blight, biotechnological failures, and the slow erosion that comes with time.
